scenarios.prompt: Using repo-kickstart, give me the ordered steps to set up the codebase-memory-mcp structure graph for a fictional TypeScript repository named acme/widget, which has committed node_modules/ and dist/ trees and no graph yet. Do not run any commands and do not create any files, banks or indexes; answer in text only. Include each command or tool call I should run and how I prove each step worked.
scenarios.assert:
L=$(tr 'A-Z' 'a-z' < result.txt | tr '
' ' ') && C=$(printf '%s
' "$L" | awk '{print index($0, ".cbmignore")}') && P=$(printf '%s
' "$L" | awk '{print match($0, /persistence[" :=]*true/)}') && X=$(printf '%s
' "$L" | awk '{print index($0, "index_repository(")}') && [ "$C" -gt 0 ] && [ "$P" -gt "$C" ] && { [ "$X" -eq 0 ] || [ "$X" -gt "$C" ]; } && ! printf '%s' "$L" | grep -qE 'persistence[" :=]*false' && printf '%s' "$L" | grep -q 'merge: ours'
scenarios.note: Rule under test: .cbmignore is written before the first indexing, indexing uses persistence=true, and git check-attr merge -- .codebase-memory/graph.db.zst must print merge: ours. The check lowercases the answer and passes when .cbmignore appears, persistence set to true appears after it, no index_repository( call comes before it, persistence is never set to false, and the answer contains 'merge: ours'. It anchors on persistence rather than on the word 'index' because the skill's own preflight names index_repository before the .cbmignore step (docs/LESSONS.md L-007). Known limits: it accepts an index instruction written in words before .cbmignore, for example 'index the repo first, then write .cbmignore, then re-index with persistence=true', because it rejects only an index_repository( call there; that case was raised in CodeRabbit's review of PR #70 and accepted as a documented limit by decision 19 of the cleanup-pass batch (HUHHB-168). It also does not check that the artifact is committed, and it fails a correct answer that writes merge:ours without the space. Both arms start from an empty directory with the installed huhhb@huhhb plugin switched off and no MCP servers (--strict-mcp-config); the skill arm loads a git archive copy of the branch with --plugin-dir, and the baseline arm also runs with no built-in tools (--tools ""), because with tools a baseline read skills/repo-kickstart from a worktree on disk and from the installed plugin cache (docs/MISTAKES.md 4.1, 4.2). Clean baseline before the first bench: 0 of 3. The first bench (at 5d3b5978, a looser check that also accepted persistence=false and check-attr alone): skill 3/3, baseline 1/2; B4 vs baseline and B8 failed and were accepted by decision 16 of the cleanup-pass batch (HUHHB-168). The check was tightened after CodeRabbit round 1 on PR #70, so it was benched again. Second bench (at f296e946): skill 3/3, baseline 0/2, so the ratio gates were skipped; every gate passed. Dropped before the first bench: ruleset-first-protection (rulesets endpoint before classic protection, no classic PUT). Its three clean baseline runs passed 2 of 3 (docs/LESSONS.md L-003). Checked for the prose case after the bench at f296e946: the bench keeps one skill-arm answer per scenario, the first passing run (scripts/skill-bench.ts:759-761), so 2 of the 6 answers were read and 4 were not kept. In both kept answers .cbmignore is written before the index call, and every earlier mention of indexing is a precondition, not an instruction to index (decision 20 of the cleanup-pass batch). Keeping every run's answer is part of HUHHB-168.
